author: More Perfect Union
description:
This farm in upstate New York almost had a data center move in right next door, but then NY got the first statewide data center moratorium in the country.

We went with Rep. AOC and Governor Kathy Hochul to talk to farmers who are thrilled the data center wasn't built, and who are still on alert for what happens when the moratorium expires.

Host and Producer: @yuremaperezhinojosa
Editor: @niklaak
Videographers: @revsouthnolan @grantconversano 
Sound Recordist: @robxyzn 
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Farmers to AOC on data centers: “there could be nothing left for us”
